info.name: Sportra API
info.description: All Sportra backend endpoints. Import, then: (1) run 'Search venues'/'Availability grid' for data, (2) log in as player / owner / admin (Auth folder) - tokens are saved automatically into the collection variables and each folder uses the right one. Login codes arrive by e-mail (dev: MailHog http://localhost:58025); put the code in the otpCode variable. Base URL is the baseUrl variable (default http://localhost:3000). Bookings use tomorrow's date; set the dateOverride variable (YYYY-MM-DD) to book another day, for example today to test check-in (check-in only opens shortly before a slot starts).

exec: // keeps date variables fresh on every send
const f = (d) => d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const now = new Date(); const t = new Date(now.getTime() + 86400000);
pm.collectionVariables.set('today', f(now));
// 'tomorrow' is the booking date used everywhere; set dateOverride (YYYY-MM-DD) to use another day, e.g. today to test check-in
const day = pm.collectionVariables.get('dateOverride') || f(t);
pm.collectionVariables.set('tomorrow', day);
pm.collectionVariables.set('blockFrom', day + 'T10:00:00+05:00');
pm.collectionVariables.set('blockTo', day + 'T12:00:00+05:00');

request.description: Creates a normal USER account. The 6-digit code is e-mailed (dev: MailHog http://localhost:58025).
signupIntent GROUND_OWNER gives the ground-owner role, which is required to create venues.
Put the e-mailed code in the otpCode variable first. Saves playerToken.

exec: const j = pm.response.json();
if (j.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('playerToken', j.accessToken); if (j.data && j.data.user) pm.collectionVariables.set('playerUserId', j.data.user.id); }

request.description: Saves ownerToken.

exec: const j = pm.response.json();
if (j.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('ownerToken', j.accessToken); if (j.data && j.data.user) pm.collectionVariables.set('ownerUserId', j.data.user.id); }
const j = pm.response.json();
if (j.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('playerToken', j.accessToken); if (j.data && j.data.user) pm.collectionVariables.set('playerUserId', j.data.user.id); }
else if (j.mfaRequired) { console.log('A login code was e-mailed (MailHog http://localhost:58025). Put it in the otpCode variable and run Verify Login OTP.'); }

request.description: Uses the refreshToken cookie set at login (Postman keeps cookies automatically). Saves a new token into playerToken - rename the variable if you refresh another user.

exec: const j = pm.response.json();
if (j.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('playerToken', j.accessToken); }

request.description: Token comes from the invitation e-mail (MailHog). Existing accounts only need the token (and must be logged in with the invited e-mail).

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.data && j.data.user && j.data.user.id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('playerUserId', v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: phone is optional too: {"phone": "+923001112233"}.
Needs seeded data (npm run db:seed). Fills venueId / venueSlug if they are still empty. The seeded venues all belong to the demo owner, so this works with the demo owner's POS calls.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const a = (d => Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d && (d.items || d.venues || d.results || d.bookings || d.slots)) || [])(j.data); if (a.length) { if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('venueId')) { pm.collectionVariables.set('venueId', a[0].id); } if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('venueSlug')) { pm.collectionVariables.set('venueSlug', a[0].slug || a[0].id); } } } catch (e) {}

try { const j = pm.response.json(); const a = (d => Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d && (d.items || d.venues || d.results || d.bookings || d.slots)) || [])(j.data); if (a.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('areaId', a[0].id); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Public slot grid with ETag. (For the booking flow use '0c. Availability grid' in the Bookings folder.)
inviteToken is saved by 'Create invite link' in the 06 Bookings folder.
Saves your first VERIFIED venue (else the first one) as venueId / venueSlug. These are used by the POS, booking and admin-grid calls, so run it after logging in as the owner.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const a = (d => Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d && (d.items || d.venues || d.results || d.bookings || d.slots)) || [])(j.data); const v = a.find(x => x.verificationStatus === 'VERIFIED') || a[0]; if (v) { pm.collectionVariables.set('venueId', v.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('venueSlug', v.slug || v.id); } } catch (e) {}

request.description: Needs the GROUND_OWNER role (register with signupIntent GROUND_OWNER, or log in as the seeded demo owner). A normal user gets 403 PERMISSION_DENIED. areaId is optional: add it later with 'Update venue'. Saves newVenueId, which the rest of this folder and the admin review use.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.data && j.data.id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('newVenueId', v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Any create-venue field can be changed while the venue is a draft. To add an area later, add "areaId": "{{areaId}}" to the body (areaId is saved by 'List areas' in Discovery). Area is optional.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.url) { pm.collectionVariables.set('photoUrl', j.data.url); } } catch (e) {}

request.description: Body > form-data, key 'file' (type File): pick a JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. Cloudinary stores it and the response returns data.url. This call only stores the file; save the link in our database by sending it in 'Update venue' as "photos": ["{{photoUrl}}"]. Needs OWNER or MANAGER of the venue. The link is saved as photoUrl.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data && j.data.url) { pm.collectionVariables.set('courtPhotoUrl', j.data.url); } } catch (e) {}

request.description: Same as 'Upload venue photo' but stored in the court folder. Save the returned link with 'Add court' or 'Update court' in the court's "images" list, e.g. "images": ["{{courtPhotoUrl}}"]. The link is saved as courtPhotoUrl.

One call creates the court with its images, its own weekly opening hours (schedule; leave it out to use the venue's hours) and its price bands (pricing; leave it out to add bands later). environment is INDOOR or OUTDOOR (required); sport and surface are required; images: up to 10 URLs; isBookable false hides the court from players. If a price band is invalid nothing is created. priceMinor is in paisa. Repeat this request for every court of the ground (futsal, padel, cricket nets...).

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.data && j.data.id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('newCourtId', v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Any court field can be changed. isBookable false switches the court off. "schedule": null makes the court follow the venue hours again.
Shows what each slot of the day will cost.
Adds one more band to an existing court (a higher priority wins where bands overlap). Used here to demonstrate deleting a rule (next request).

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = j.data && j.data.id; if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('ruleId', v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Deletes the extra weekend rule saved above. Rules can only be changed while the venue is a draft.
Needs a court, pricing that covers the opening hours and a map pin. The admin then reviews it (Admin folder).

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const v = (d => Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d && (d.items || d.staff)) || [])(j.data).filter(x => x.role !== 'OWNER').map(x => x.membershipId || x.id).find(Boolean); if (v) pm.collectionVariables.set('membershipId', v); } catch (e) {}

request.description: role: MANAGER, FRONT_DESK or SCORER. The invitation token arrives by e-mail (MailHog); paste it into inviteToken and run 'Accept staff invitation'.
membershipId is saved by 'List staff' (the first non-owner member). The owner cannot be removed.
Runs with the OWNER token. Saves the venue the player will book at, so the POS (check-in) belongs to the same venue.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const a = (d => Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d && (d.items || d.venues || d.results || d.bookings || d.slots)) || [])(j.data); const v = a.find(x => x.verificationStatus === 'VERIFIED') || a[0]; if (v) { pm.collectionVariables.set('venueId', v.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('venueSlug', v.slug || v.id); } } catch (e) {}

request.description: Runs with the OWNER token. Needed once so the player can 'confirm pay at venue'.
Saves a free slotId + courtId and, if the next hour is free too, slotId2 (the hold uses both).

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const s = (j.data && j.data.slots || []).filter(x => x.status === 'AVAILABLE');
pm.collectionVariables.set('slotId', ''); pm.collectionVariables.set('slotId2', '');
if (s.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('slotId', s[0].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('courtId', s[0].courtId);
const next = s.find(x => x.courtId === s[0].courtId && new Date(x.startAt).getTime() === new Date(s[0].endAt).getTime());
if (next) pm.collectionVariables.set('slotId2', next.id); } } catch (e) {}

request.description: Shows what a cancel would refund or forfeit. Needs itemId2 (the booking must have 2 hours).

request.description: Cancels only the second hour, so the booking stays active for the POS calls. Omit itemIds to cancel everything.
Only works while a booking is still an unconfirmed hold: start a fresh 'Hold slots' first.
Turn on so players can 'confirm pay at venue'.
Saves two free slots of this venue (posSlotId, posSlotId2) for the walk-in and manual bookings below.

exec: try { const j = pm.response.json(); const s = (j.data && j.data.slots || []).filter(x => x.status === 'AVAILABLE');
pm.collectionVariables.set('posSlotId', ''); pm.collectionVariables.set('posSlotId2', '');
if (s.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('posSlotId', s[0].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('posCourtId', s[0].courtId); }
if (s.length > 1) { pm.collectionVariables.set('posSlotId2', s[1].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('posCourtId2', s[1].courtId); } } catch (e) {}

decision: APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED or REJECTED (comments required unless approving). Optional fieldFlags: [{field, note}].

request.description: The Idempotency-Key must be a UUID. Optional itemIds cancels single hours.
Only slots that are manually BLOCKED can be unblocked (409 INVALID_SLOT_TRANSITION otherwise).
Server-sent events stream; it stays open. For staff add header Authorization: Bearer {{ownerToken}} and enable the pos parameter. Socket.IO clients connect to path /realtime.
